# secureaccess_resource_connector_group (Data Source)

This data source reads the Resource Connector Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_resource_connector_group" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Id of the object

### Read-Only

- `environment` (String) Environment in which agents will be deployed.
- `name` (String) Name of the Resource Connector Group.
- `region` (String) The region where to deploy Resource Connector Group on Cisco Secure Access.
